theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (ν : Measure X) (S : Set X) (r g : X → ℝ) (F F' : ℝ → ℝ) (σ ρ : ℝ), SFinite ν → MeasurableSet S → Measurable r → (∀ x ∈ S, r x ∈ Ioc σ ρ) → IntegrableOn g S ν → IntegrableOn F' (Ioc σ ρ) → (∀ t ∈ Icc σ ρ, F t = F σ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ t, F' τ) → IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ g x * (F (r x) - F σ)) S ν ∧ IntegrableOn (fun t ↦ F' t * ∫ x in S ∩ {x | t < r x}, g x ∂ν) (Ioc σ ρ) ∧ ∫ t in Ioc σ ρ, F' t * ∫ x in S ∩ {x | t < r x}, g x ∂ν = ∫ x in S, g x * (F (r x) - F σ) ∂ν
